english.title: Fail to notify Secretary of State of material change to information on an influence activity or arrangement
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) having registered a

(A)_[foreign influence arrangement under section 69]_
(B)_[political influence activity under section 72]_

of the National Security Act 2023, failed, within 14 days of a material change to the information provided to the Secretary of State

(C)_[on registration]_
(D)_[in response under section 75 of the Act to an information notice]_

taking effect, to inform the Secretary of State of the change so that, as a result of the failure, the information provided in relation to the registered arrangement or activity was false, inaccurate or misleading in a material way
english.legislation: Contrary to sections 74(5) and (8) and 80(3) of the National Security Act 2023.

other.penalty:
Either way
Summary: maximum 6/12 months imprisonment and / or fine.
Indictment : maximum 2 years imprisonment and / or fine.

The maximum penalty on summary conviction depends on the general limit in a magistrates’ court and may be 6 or 12 months depending on the date of conviction, see section 224(1) and (1A) of the Sentencing Act 2020.​​​​​​​

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
